description:
Does God forgive me no matter what? Why do my sins come back to haunt me? Find out the answer to these questions—and many more—on 3ABN Today Bible Q & A with J. D. Quinn, Jason Bradley, John Lomacang, and John Dinzey.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.  Are the promises of Jesus to the seven churches specific or in general for all overcomers of all ages? 

2.  Will God forgive us no matter what we have done? 

3.  I’m an Adventist since birth. I know right from wrong but because of the power of choice, I sometimes choose to do wrong. I know in my heart that after I commit the sin I will feel bad and confess, but after a few days or months, I do the same thing over and over again. Sometimes I even think in my heart to do the sin anyway and just confess after and I will be okay. Have I already filled God’s cup of wrath against me so that He will no longer listen to me? How will I know that God has not abandoned me yet despite this sinning-repenting-repenting-sinning scenario? Will there still be room for forgiveness? 
 
4.  In Rev 16:13-14, it says "And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet. For they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty."  According to the above verses, does the devil have an evil spirit in him? If so does the word spirit refer to character? 

5.  Why did Lot offer his daughters to the evil men of Sodom in place of the angels? This seems to me just as evil. 

6. God spoke to me saying "once you are under my house you are under my rules, I am God.” Was it God’s voice? 
 
7. According to Luke 24, when Jesus met with His disciples after His resurrection, He (Jesus) ate boiled fish with them. How do we explain the fact that Jesus ate dead fish while in His glorified body? (Note from Al: Thank you for your text and link to my Q&A I am well aware of the clean and unclean issue but Pastor Lomacang mentioned in closing that we would not eat animals in heaven which I am totally in agreement however; Jesus had been to heaven after His resurrection yet when He met with the disciples in Luke 24 He ate boiled fish. That is the part I have questions about. How do we explain to others the fact that Jesus ate dead fish while in HIS glorified body.) 

8.  Where in the Bible does it say that there are varying degrees of punishment for the wicked and especially since punishment is usually metered out to influence correction? 

9.  In the Bible, especially in the Old Testament, it talks about wars multiple times in fact God used to equip people to go war. Ephesians 6 says to girdle with God's armor. Based on God's word, what’s your opinion about the wars that are happening all over the world today? Is it necessary? 

10.  The Bible says "If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive those sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness" 1 John 1:9. “Your sins and iniquities I will remember no more" Hebrews 8:12. "We’re delivered from corruption and our sins are cast behind His back" Isaiah 38:17. “He will have compassion on us and cast our sins into the depths of the sea" Micah 7:19. We read it and believe it but even after all of the safeguards taken, why do these sins keep coming back to haunt us? 

11.  In Genesis, after Cain killed Abel and was sent out of the Garden of Eden, he feared the people whom he would encounter. Who were these people and where did they come from? 

12.  Does Malachi 3:10 apply to me totally or partially since I am retired now?
